Subject: Intro + Exec sponsor demo — two proposed slots

Hi Emma,

Great to meet on the quick discovery call last week — thanks for sharing the high-level priorities. Per our conversation, we'd like to set up a short executive / sponsor demo so your leadership (VP/CTO) can see the end-to-end flow and confirm success criteria. Goal is a 30–45 minute session: 20 minute demo + 15 minute Q&A / next steps.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Thursday 2027-03-24, 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Thursday 2027-03-24, 3:00–3:45 PM PT

If either of those doesn't work, happy to move to next week — we want to be flexible around Rajiv's schedule. Quick asks:
- Can your VP or CTO join for at least the first 20–30 minutes?
- Any particular concerns we should plan to address (latency targets, data residency, integration timeline)?

I've attached a one-page agenda to keep things focused (Attachment: agenda_v1.pdf). CC'ing Karthik (AE) and Marcus (Solutions) who will run the demo.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
